tool_args.rationale: The observed slow-horizon and fast-transient-damped signatures, together with only five paid rows and confounded inputs, leave genuine identifiability uncertainty. The available fine trajectory batch is the relevant probe to distinguish temporal behavior before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a numerical model from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The inputs are strongly coupled (u_past, u_now, and mem_conv co-vary), all s_grad values are zero, and the slow-horizon signature makes the target forecast horizon consequential; key temporal mechanisms remain unidentified.
This auxiliary is explicitly nuisance and would not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
